title: Kara:
title_q: “What I Do When My Baby Is Stuffy”
headline: Kara gets home, sees her 3-month-old is congested, and clears it out right away so it doesn't turn into something worse. Then it's nap time.
story: This is Peter's Tips video: What I Do When My Baby Gets Stuffy. It is Kara's own routine in her own words. The BN02 is part of it, not the star: one short mention, soft sell.

What only Kara says: she acts early so it doesn't turn to something worse, and her baby is calm through it. That is the spine. The other tip video in this batch (Jordana) is a different mom and a different story: do not copy its shots or its order.
Loops: L1 “What does she do?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:10. L2 “Is the baby okay with it?” opens at 0:10 and closes at 0:22. Stakes: a stuffy nose that could turn into something worse.
do: Open on Kara already talking, hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Keep her words. Cut the pauses and the false starts.
Cut away to the baby's calm face and the BN02 close-ups often, so it is never just a talking head.
Keep the product mention to one line.
End on the baby going into the crib for her nap.
dont: No logo, no name card, no fade at 0:00.
Never use Atdhe's voice. He feeds her lines in most takes.
No shot of the baby fussing. Tip on the nose only.
No feature list. Skip the 'one, two, three' button tour in IMG_9349 00:10 to 00:45.
Do not use the purple-top takes (IMG_9345 to IMG_9347) with the lavender ones: two outfits in one tip looks wrong.
